mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the 3-month federal funds rate over the next 60 days predicts a forward discount rate compression, increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the 3-month federal funds rate above 4.5% over the next 20 days signals tightening, raising discount rates and compressing forward equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) over the next 20 days predicts stronger labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below -1% over the next 20 days signals contraction, reducing consumer confidence and equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the monthly Industrial Production index (INDPRO) below 105 over the next 60 days predicts weakening demand absorption, compressing forward equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the monthly Industrial Production index (INDPRO) above 110 over the next 60 days signals strong demand absorption, boosting forward equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly housing starts (HOUST) below 1400 over the next 20 days predicts cooling in the housing market, reducing equity price sensitivity to interest rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in cooling periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in monthly housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 over the next 20 days signals a heating housing market, increasing equity price sensitivity to interest rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in heating periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
